purpose: Teach: コピペ/うんこ/メイル/クリエーター/できよ/チョー/シャラ/コットン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「コピペで済まさないで自分で考えなさい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said you shouldn't just copy-paste—you need to think it through yourself.
lines.style: Light, informational delivery. Matter-of-fact relay of parental wisdom, but with warmth underneath. No lecture, just passing it along. Slight knowing tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「うんこドリル」で漢字書き取り練習したよ
lines.en: Mom, I studied kanji with Dad using the Unko Drill.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice with genuine pride. Quick delivery. Small-boy enthusiasm that doesn't need performance—it's real. Expectant, like he wants her to acknowledge this small victory with him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメイル、つまりメールで連絡されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has been emailing me about your progress.
lines.style: Calm, reflective tone. Speaking a small observation aloud rather than at the boy. Gentle fondness for the detail of it—that his husband is keeping her updated. Slight warm smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクリエーターの作品集観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a creator's portfolio with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, open delivery. Sits a little forward in the voice. Wants her to understand this was something special he did with Dad. Genuine interest shining through, not rehearsed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古風に「できよ」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad used that old-fashioned expression—'dekiyo.'
lines.style: Dry, slightly amused observation. Quick beat on the word choice itself. Fondness mixed with wry humor at her husband's dated vocabulary. Not mocking, but noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「『チョー』は時代を映す言葉」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that 'cho' is a word that reflects the times we live in.
lines.style: Thoughtful, earnest delivery. Sho is repeating something he found interesting and wants to hold onto it. Careful, reverent even—Dad's idea, passed to him. Slower pace, reflective.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがテニスのシャラポワのインタビュー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been watching an interview with Sharapova about tennis.
lines.style: Detached observation, almost to herself. A small snapshot of what he's doing. Warm underlying tone—she notices what interests him. No judgment, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとコットン100%のシーツを購入したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought some 100% cotton sheets.
lines.style: Contentment in the voice. Warm closing note, like the day with Dad is wrapping up gently. Small, satisfied delivery. Pride in the small practical thing they chose together.
